_about: Rulings on the first-line indent check (`harness zones paragraphs`): measured indents a human has judged NOT to be paragraph openings. The check's findings are questions about this store — a real one is answered by splitting the band in the editor — and this is where the other answer goes, so the worklist empties instead of returning on every run. Same shape as _ink_exempt.json: keyed PP-NNN, scoped to a band of the page rather than to the page, and the note is required, because 'the tool complained and I made it stop' is not a record of anything. A ruled start still reports, flagged `ruled` and carrying its note — 1-334's 1262 px and 1-196's 311 px are not paragraphs but they are saying something about short ink runs, and a ledger that hid them would lose it. The book sets its paragraph indent at 107-110 px and its full measure at ~1740 px; every entry below is far from the first, short of the second, or both.
